title: Dealer support and unclear service details
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes a clear complaint about ongoing vehicle problems with dealer loaners, a standalone positive statement of satisfaction, and several fragments that mention service or repairs without enough context for a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review expresses overall satisfaction with the vehicle without giving specific feature or service details.

negative.summary: The negative review describes ongoing problems with the vehicle while noting the dealership provided loaner cars and showed concern.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention a properly working shade, costly post-crash safety-tech repairs, and a dealer visit with no further detail, so sentiment cannot be assigned confidently.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a single clear theme.
